profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Ridgeline
profile.summary: RIT Alumni. B.S. in Information Technology.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Logikcull is a cloud-based, powerfully simple eDiscovery solution used by legal teams to automate many aspects of discovery.

As a member of the core processing team, I contributed to the daily operations of processing millions of documents working with Ruby, MongoDB, and orchestrating tasks with Sidekiq and Resque jobs.

Spent most of my tenure expanding platform capabilities utilizing a tech stack consisting of Postgres, NodeJS, TypeScript, and Temporal. Major projects included integrating and consuming 3rd party data to transform millions of chat documents and enabling support for audio file redactions.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Whoop is an advanced fitness and health wearable used to monitor your sleep, strain, recovery, and health.

I was a Technical Lead for first the Enterprise and then Core Physiology (Strain) teams. I managed and worked along side engineers ranging from intern to senior levels. Utilized Java with Dropwizard, SQS, Kafka and Postgres to develop scalable backend services and Restful APIs for mobile applications to work with.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
While on the Community team, built an integration with Strava and engineered in-app team leaderboards, implementing unique optimization strategies to enhance team collaboration and performance tracking.

Early in my tenure, played a pivotal role in supporting business migration to subscription models, leveraging NodeJS and seamless integrations with Salesforce and Stripe. I also spent a large portion of my role as a web developer working on our AngularJS checkout site and web application.

positions.title: IT Analyst
positions.description: As a part of Liberty Mutual IT Analytic Platforms & Services I worked on the Customer Data Solutions Team supporting Corporate HR and driving the adoption of analytic platforms that enabled data science, developer and analytics productivity within Enterprise Technology Services and across other LM business units. I worked with PowerBI, Neo4j Graph Databases, SQL Server Integration Services, Informatica, Cisco's Data Virtualization Server, Python and an in house text analytics platform to provide reporting, data products and innovative solutions for customers.

positions.title: ETS Mobile Solution Delivery Intern
positions.description: Engaged with mobile team on large file share initiative (ShareFile) and helped test new mobile capabilities (MobileIron). Supported team with service improvement and integration for Perfecto Mobile software. Created automation scripts, reviewed processes and made suggestions.

positions.title: Database Administrator and UNIX Intern
positions.description: Worked primarily on a database team but also had some experience with both storage and unix teams. I was in charge of managing a security queue for database access and roles along with various project based tasks while working closely with the DBAs.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked within the company's accounting department organizing the departments paperwork. This included designing a new file structure layout, scanning physical documents and organizing them. I performed various other activities such as editing company policy documents in adobe.

honors.title: Summa Cum Laude
honors.description: Graduated with above a 3.80 cumulative GPA.
honors.issuer: Issued by Rochester Institute of Technology · May 2016

honors.title: Outstanding Undergraduate Award
honors.description:
A minimum grade-point average of 3.85 out of 4.0; completion of more than two-thirds of the credit hours required for a bachelor's degree and demonstrated community engagement, such as creative work, serve on student committees, civic activities, employment or independent research. 

"RIT is pleased to pay tribute to these undergraduates whose demonstrated devotion to excellence is an inspiration to the university community," said Jeremy Haefner, RIT provost and senior vice president of Academic Affairs
honors.issuer: Issued by Rochester Institute of Technology · Apr 2016
